name: robots/hogunkee__robocasa_g1
title: RoboCasa-G1 G1 arms-and-waist tabletop environment (simulation)
intro: RoboCasa-G1 G1 arms-and-waist tabletop environment (simulation), adapted from hogunkee/robocasa_g1. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset_world` and `set_seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
